ruling.recommended_action: Route to human review: assess the rider's threat message (SAFE-1) and separately review the 0.77 km off-route segment for possible partial metered-fare refund; no automated refund issued.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety: chat-threat keyword detected in rider message #1 ("I'll find you", 09:35) — threat/intimidation keyword per SAFE-1, so no automated ruling on the route-deviation dispute.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:49–09:52 (2.15 km vs 1.38 km optimal, +0.77 km) is not exempted: RD-4(a) fails because there is no traffic incident on the replaced optimal route [F12] (band-4 speeds [F10][F11] are neither incidents nor band 1/2, and a lone band record cannot exempt per RD-4(b)/G3), RD-4(c) directs it to RD-2 treatment, and RD-5 fails because no pre-deviation route-change consent appears in chat [F7][F8]. Segment exempt = false; refund calculation RD-2 = 0.77 km × $1.409/km ≈ $1.08 is left to human review.
